positive_definition: background-corrected Indel_accu% >0.1; strict boundary matches selected assay description; >=0.1 sensitivity analysis reported separately
negative_definition: experimentally assayed boolean-Validation rows with finite corrected indel <=0.1%; unassayed candidates, PCR failures and missing/censored values excluded
detection_limit: study/database nominal0.1% targeted-sequencing sensitivity; no read-depth-based site-specific LoD can be independently established from summary table
guide_context: 20nt standard sgRNA with intended NGG; no HF variants, prime/base editors or crRNA modifications pooled
score_scope: all eligible ungapped assayed20nt pairs, with native target-PAM CFD scoring; prior workflow NGG/<=3mm coverage reported separately
training_exclusion: CFD learned mismatch/PAM rules derive from Doench2016 mismatch screen; no retraining/tuning here. Selected independent study PMID recorded; if26780180 is selected, block as training-source overlap.
metrics: average precision, trapezoid PR-AUC, per-guide recall@K on assayed candidate universe, precision@K; no genome-wide or clinical recall claim
population: no variant panels, phased haplotypes, bulges or structural variants evaluated
important_limit: selection conditions on nomination/assay testing; summary-table labels do not create a representative genome-wide negative set
